paper_title: Limits from the Funk Experiment on the Mixing Strength of Hidden-Photon Dark Matter in the Visible and Near-Ultraviolet Wavelength Range
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless (plot shows lg(chi); values converted as 10^(lg chi))
notes: FUNK dish-antenna search for hidden-photon dark matter using a 14.56 m^2 spherical mirror and PMT. No signal observed; upper limit chi < 6.65e-13 at 95% C.L. quoted in text for the HP mass range 1.95-8.55 eV, encoded here as a flat two-point bound. The paper states a mass-resolved limit is tabulated in Appendix A (Figs. 23-24), but that table was not included in the provided content, so only the flat text-quoted value is extracted.
